project: Wuxia Life P68 Merchant Trilogy Live Experience Validation
description: Validate whether the completed merchant trilogy optimization sequence is actually player-perceivable through bounded replay, playtest-style readout, and methodology-transfer judgment, without reopening merchant implementation scope.

userStories.title: Audit existing merchant trilogy validation assets
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of existing merchant trilogy proof, test, replay, and playtest-style assets so P68 can reuse real repo evidence instead of inventing a parallel validation workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize the existing merchant trilogy proof, tests, replay-style assets, and playtest-style documents
Separate assets that are directly reusable from validation gaps that still need bounded readout support
Save docs/test-reports/p68-merchant-trilogy-validation-asset-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Asset audit complete: 7 proof docs, 6 test suites, 8 closure reports identified. Gaps: no trilogy-specific comparison readout, no intra-merchant playtest, no fixed verdict contract, no transfer readiness judgment.

userStories.title: Lock P68 validation scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P68 stays a bounded replay, playtest, and verdict stage rather than slipping into fresh merchant implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P68 to replay, playtest-style readout, comparison, and verdict work
Define allowed layers: documentation, minimum validation scripts, and comparison readout
List forbidden expansions: new merchant content, new systems, new bridges, and new mixed endings
Save docs/test-reports/p68-merchant-trilogy-validation-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope contract complete: 4 allowed layers (docs, min scripts, comparison readout, verdict framework), 5 forbidden expansions (new content, new systems, new bridges, new endings, platformization).

userStories.title: Define merchant trilogy experience verdict contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a fixed verdict contract so P68 evaluates the trilogy on consistent player-facing dimensions across apprentice, tavern, and peasant routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Define at least three fixed player-facing dimensions: success cost, success shape, and destiny-sentence recall
Define pass, warning, and fail judgment rules for those dimensions
Explain how replay evidence and human-readable playtest evidence combine into one verdict
Record the verdict contract in the PRD or an appendix artifact
userStories.notes: Verdict contract complete: 3 dimensions (success-cost, success-shape, destiny-sentence recall); pass/warning/fail rules; replay+playtest combination matrix; overall verdict rollup; transfer-readiness threshold. Recorded in PRD Appendix A + standalone doc.

userStories.title: Produce a bounded merchant trilogy comparison readout
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one bounded comparison readout that lets the three merchant routes be reviewed side by side without requiring a platformized playtest system.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce one merchant trilogy comparison-style readout
Cover apprentice, tavern, and peasant routes in the same artifact
Ground the comparison in success-cost, success-shape, and destiny-sentence evidence
Do not require a full lifetime exhaustive matrix
userStories.notes: Comparison readout complete: 3 routes × 3 dimensions (success-cost, success-shape, destiny-sentence). All 3 dimensions pass on replay evidence. Bounded scope: payoff-phase focused, not full lifetime exhaust.

userStories.title: Run merchant trilogy human-readable playtest readout
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a human-readable playtest-style verdict that answers whether the trilogy now feels like three different lives rather than one merchant path with variations.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce at least one human-readable merchant trilogy playtest readout
State pass, warning, or fail for each of the three routes
State whether players can retell the differences among the three routes
Do not require platformized external-user research
userStories.notes: Playtest readout complete: all 3 routes pass (5/5 each); 30-second retell test pass — all 3 clearly distinguishable. Overall verdict: Pass (3/3 dimensions pass). Trilogy feels like 3 different lives, not 1 path with variations.

userStories.title: Judge methodology transfer readiness
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a formal judgment on whether the merchant trilogy optimization method is stable enough to transfer to another route.
acceptanceCriteria: State whether the method has reached a transfer-ready threshold
If the method is not transfer-ready, identify whether the blocker is validation weakness or content weakness
If the method is transfer-ready, state the minimum stage order that must be preserved when transferring it
Write the conclusion into closure or verdict documentation
userStories.notes: Methodology is TRANSFER-READY. All 3 dimensions pass (replay + playtest). Minimum stage order: bridges → entry → flavor → cost → shape+recap. 5 known caveats documented (expression-only, 3-route bias, ordinary→mixed bias, destiny sentence UI gap, internal review only).

userStories.title: Add narrow validation reinforcement if needed
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want only the minimum additional validation support needed if existing merchant trilogy evidence is insufficient for a transfer-readiness judgment.
acceptanceCriteria: If existing validation assets are sufficient, record that no additional validation is needed
If existing validation is insufficient, add only the smallest readout or comparison-level validation asset needed
Do not rewrite the main P58 through P67 test systems
Relevant commands pass
userStories.notes: No additional validation needed. Existing assets (P58-P67 proofs + tests + P68-004 comparison + P68-005 playtest) are sufficient. Typecheck + p50SampleLineExpressionTests both pass.

userStories.title: Produce P68 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating whether the merchant trilogy method is now player-validated and ready to inform the next route choice.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p68-merchant-trilogy-live-experience-closure-report.md
Summarize the asset audit, scope contract, verdict contract, comparison readout, playtest readout, and transfer-readiness judgment
State the boundary between P68 and P69
List full playtest or platformization items that remain deferred
userStories.notes: Closure report complete. Overall verdict: Pass (3/3 dimensions). Methodology: TRANSFER-READY. Zero runtime changes, all tests pass. P68/P69 boundary defined. 6 deferred items documented.
